description: Checks the previous step's artifact with its own evidence and routes the crossing.

producao.description: the bucket the `implementar` node declares in `contract.produces`; it is where the previous step's structured output lands in the input projection (t253)

outcome.description: required in every skill whose role is `gate`; the edge the executor takes comes from the result the NODE's contract declares.

preconditions: the previous step left the artifact in the session directory

checks.description: An agentic gate checks with its own evidence, never with the report of whoever produced it.
checks.instruction: Read the previous step's artifact and say whether it meets what was asked for. Attach the excerpt you read.

instructions:
# Check one step of the crossing

The previous step reported: {{input.producao.nota}}

Read what the previous step produced and judge it with your own evidence: the
report of whoever produced it does not count as proof.

You write no file at all. Your output is the verdict.
